correctness.rationale: Each source cell pushes a uniform conditional location to a uniform location on its three target cells; induction on the itinerary proves the four-cell Markov law with stationary weights (1/6,1/3,1/3,1/6). Row sums by sign give strong lumpability and the symmetric sign chain (stay probability 2/3) for the specified stationary start. For an independent all-lag calculation, take an odd density g written a+bx on the positive inner cell and c+dx on the positive outer cell. The four affine inverse branches send it to 2kx on the inner cell and C+kx on the outer cell, with k=(d−b)/9 and C=(a+c)/3+(b+2d)/9. On this resulting subspace let w=C+k. Subsequent transfers update w to w/3 and k to −k/9. The S and X integrals are respectively w+k/4 and 3w/4. The first transfer from xh has (w,k)=(1/9,−1/27), and from (sgn x)h it has (1/3,0). They give all four asserted correlations at positive lags, and elementary integration against h gives lag zero. The affine slope and constant blocks in even parity have eigenvalues (0,1/9) and (0,1); the odd ones have (0,−1/9) and (0,1/3), also recovering the stated characteristic polynomial. The directed difference is strictly positive, beginning at 4/27. Marginal geometric covariances give the two finite-window variance formulas; the irreducible aperiodic sign-chain CLT has variance 2. No coordinate CLT is needed.
residual_risks: Stationary absolutely continuous initialization and the single deterministic parameter choice are essential to the word law used here. Boundary points do not affect these statements. The negative mode is in E[X₀Sₙ] and the directed difference, not in the opposite cross-correlation or either marginal.

value.rationale: The parameter is selected by the turning-point two-cycle, not an arbitrary numeric slice. It provides a finite-leakage benchmark where an exact reversible sign model omits a strictly directed mixed covariance, even though both marginal sequences have only one geometric decay. The explicit negative mode and which observation hides it distinguish this from merely constructing a Markov partition or proving a CLT by standard theory.
residual_risks: This is a model-specific benchmark, not a theorem that nearby parameters or random dynamics share exact lumpability or the mode.
